External Integration Resilience (save first, warn on API failure)
Capacity Feature (allocation model, math, heat dashboard)

nodes.label: Next.js Agent Rules Block
nodes.rationale: Written and re-added automatically by `next dev` (generate-agent-files.js) to force agents to read the bundled docs in node_modules/next/dist/docs because this Next.js version has breaking changes vs training data; removing it from a diff only re-creates the uncommitted change.

nodes.label: LogPup Implementation Plan
nodes.rationale: 19-task checkbox plan for agentic workers (superpowers:subagent-driven-development); one commit per task, TDD on pure logic (slugify, allocation, permissions, Notion blocks), manual human prerequisites isolated up front.

nodes.label: Next.js 16 Monolith Architecture
nodes.rationale: No REST/tRPC layer: Server Components read the DB via Drizzle and all mutations are Server Actions, with feature folders under src/features/* each owning queries.ts, actions.ts, components/. Next 16 specifics: Turbopack default, params/searchParams are Promises, route guard in src/proxy.ts.

nodes.label: Drizzle Schema (7 tables, Neon Postgres)
nodes.rationale: Tables users, apps, assignments, sprints, tasks, meetings, meetingAttendees with enums userRole/appStatus/sprintStatus/taskStatus; column names declared canonical so later tasks must match exactly. neon-http has no transactions, so multi-statement writes use db.batch.

nodes.label: Auth.js v5 Google Sign-In
nodes.rationale: JWT sessions with no adapter tables — users provisioned in the signIn callback; sign-in restricted to ALLOWED_EMAIL_DOMAIN emails; calendar.events scope with offline access stores googleRefreshToken; Credentials provider exists only as an E2E bypass gated by E2E_TEST_MODE=1.

nodes.label: proxy.ts Route Guard
nodes.rationale: Next 16 deprecates middleware.ts in favor of src/proxy.ts, which runs the Node.js runtime, so DB calls inside auth callbacks are unrestricted; unauthenticated requests redirect to /sign-in.

nodes.label: ActionResult Pattern
nodes.rationale: Every Server Action validates input with zod, checks the session, and returns a typed ActionResult<T> ({ ok: true, data } | { ok: false, error }) — never throwing to the client; failures surface as toasts.

nodes.label: Allocation Math (summarizeAllocations)
nodes.rationale: Pure TDD function summing allocationPct per user and flagging totalPct > 100 as overallocated; over-allocation warns but is still saved (spec: warn, never block).

nodes.label: Capacity Heat Dashboard
nodes.rationale: Team capacity card sorted overallocated-first with CapacityBar (green <=80, amber 81-100, red >100) so over-100% users float to the top with a red badge.

nodes.label: Task Move Permissions (canMoveTask)
nodes.rationale: Single-source-of-truth pure helper: admin moves anything; member moves only tasks assigned to self; enforced server-side in moveTask and reused client-side to disable dragging.

nodes.label: Kanban Board (dnd-kit + optimistic)
nodes.rationale: useOptimistic over board state with DndContext onDragEnd -> optimistic move -> startTransition(moveTask); on failure a toast shows and server revalidation restores truth (snap-back).

nodes.label: Meetings Feature
nodes.rationale: calendarWarning is typed into createMeeting's result one task before Calendar wiring so the action signature never changes; attendees prefill from the selected app's team.

nodes.label: Google Calendar Integration
nodes.rationale: OAuth2 client built from the creator's stored googleRefreshToken creates events with sendUpdates:'all'; missing token or API failure returns a calendarWarning instead of failing the save, with retryCalendarInvite as the recovery path.

nodes.label: Notion Export (one-way)
nodes.rationale: buildBlocks is a pure TDD-tested block builder; upsertSprintPage reuses sprints.notionPageId so re-export updates the same Notion page (delete children + append) instead of creating duplicates.

nodes.label: Command Palette (Cmd+K) + Empty States
nodes.rationale: Global palette with debounced searchAll server action (people/apps/sprints/meetings, ilike, limit 5 per group) plus designed empty states on every list surface — no blank divs.

nodes.label: Playwright E2E Smoke Suite
nodes.rationale: Uses the Credentials bypass (E2E_TEST_MODE=1 only; must never ship enabled in production) with CSRF-token POST to seed auth state; asserts calendar failure does not block meeting save; visibility waits only, no waitForTimeout.

nodes.label: LogPup
nodes.rationale: Internal project-management webapp for a tech lead managing 30+ people across many internal apps; answers three daily questions: who works on what (and how loaded), what is each team shipping this sprint, and how to get the right people into a meeting fast.

nodes.label: Admin/Member Role Model
nodes.rationale: Only two auth roles: admin (the tech lead, full access) and member (reads all, updates own task status); app-level 'lead' is deliberately a designation on the app record, not a separate auth role. Enforced in every action, not just UI.

nodes.label: Capacity & Allocation Model
nodes.rationale: assignments join users to apps with a role and allocation %, unique per (user, app); per-user allocation sum drives the capacity view and over 100% sets an overallocated flag that warns but never blocks.

nodes.label: Non-Blocking Integration Failures
nodes.rationale: External APIs (Notion, Google Calendar) must never block the core DB save: save first, then call the API; the record persists and the integration error surfaces separately as a toast with a retry affordance.

nodes.label: YAGNI Out-of-Scope Boundary
nodes.rationale: Two-way Notion sync, epics/story points/velocity/burndown, time tracking, timeboxed allocation history, Slack/Teams notifications, and mobile app are excluded — all can be added later without schema upheaval.

nodes.label: LogPup UI Redesign Design Spec
nodes.rationale: Visual + UX pass only: each page keeps its existing data flow, shared src/components/ui/* primitives are frozen during the parallel pass, vitest suites must stay green, and no schema or server-action behavior changes beyond the additive search action.

nodes.label: Watchdog Calm
nodes.rationale: The UI should feel alert but unhurried — warm paper-like surfaces, deep pine green as the working color, one ember-amber highlight reserved for capacity/attention; dog personality appears only in microcopy, never in chrome. Explicitly avoids cream+serif+terracotta, near-black+acid-green, broadsheet hairlines, and the neutral-gray shadcn default being replaced.

nodes.label: Design Tokens (oklch color, type, motion)
nodes.rationale: oklch palette (warm stone light / spruce charcoal dark, pine primary, ember attention); semantic ramps derive from existing hues, never new ones. Type: Cabinet Grotesk display, Satoshi body, Geist Mono with tabular-nums for slugs/dates/counts. Motion 120-250ms transform+opacity only, prefers-reduced-motion respected.

nodes.label: Command Center (Cmd+K Palette)
nodes.rationale: The product's front door: Spotlight-style palette from a visible header button ('Fetch anything… Cmd+K'); one universal index over pages/apps/people/tasks/sprints plus actions; server action universalSearch (debounced, min 2 chars), client-filtered static commands, recents in localStorage; every entity reachable in <=3 keystrokes.

nodes.label: Designed Loading/Empty/Error States
nodes.rationale: Every async surface gets designed loading/empty/error states; empty states use the watchdog voice plus a clear next action ('Nothing to fetch here yet. Add your first app.').

nodes.label: Fontshare Free Font EULA
nodes.rationale: Free fonts distributed via fontshare.com: free personal/commercial use in any media, but no modification, redistribution, or font-serving via EOT/Cufon/sIFR-style technologies; derivative works belong to the Licensor; governed by Indian law (Ahmedabad jurisdiction).
